const stored = {};
function nonliteral({ outer: { value = 1 } } = { outer: stored }) {
  return value;
}

function pair({ outer: { first = 1, second = 2 } = {} } = { outer: { second: 4 } }) {
  return first + second;
}
pair({ outer: { first: 1, second: 3 } });
pair({ outer: {} });

function tuple({ outer: [one = 1, two = 'ok'] = [] } = { outer: [] }) {
  return [one, two];
}
tuple({ outer: [1, 'ok'] });
